snippet.title: BugPot - Demo Trailer | A Slot Machine Roguelike
snippet.description:
BugPot Demo is Out Now on Steam!

Spin the reels, match weapons and charms, build powerful combinations, and fight your way through a bizarre variety of bugs.

Every spin can change your run. Experiment with different combinations, upgrade your weapons, and adapt your strategy as the machine decides what comes next.

Spin. Match. Fight. Repeat.

Play the free demo now on Steam and wishlist BugPot ahead of Steam Next Fest - October 2026.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4676260/Puckn_Hell/

Discord: https://discord.gg/yrkNYzEw64
